summary.text: Chelsea Dimas is a Democratic candidate for the Washington House of Representatives, District 14-Position 1, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which she faces incumbent Gloria Mendoza (R).
A communications director and former human rights commissioner, she ran for the same seat in 2024 and lost to Mendoza.

paragraphs.text: Chelsea Dimas was born in Santa Ana, California, and graduated from Sunnyside High School and, in 2015, from Pacific Lutheran University, according to Ballotpedia.
Her career experience includes working as a communications director and as a human rights commissioner with the Washington State Human Rights Commission.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a communications professional and daughter of Indigenous immigrants from Mexico, and said her first job was picking cherries in agriculture.
Dimas ran for District 14-Position 1 in 2024, losing the general election to Mendoza, 45.5 percent to 53.9 percent.
In the August 4, 2026 primary she received 43.3 percent of the vote to Mendoza's 50.9 percent.

In her 2024 survey, Dimas listed workers' rights, immigrant and refugee rights, human rights, education, healthcare, reproductive freedom, climate change and small businesses among her policy interests.
